question.text: The positon vector <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> of a particle of mass m is given by the following equation <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mi>α</mi><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mi> </mi><mi>w</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>e</mi><mi> </mi><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac><mi> </mi><mi>m</mi><msup><mrow><mi>s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mi> </mi><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mi> </mi><mi>m</mi><msup><mrow><mi>s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi> </mi><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi> </mi><mi>m</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.1</mn><mi> </mi><mi>k</mi><mi>g</mi><mo>.</mo><mi> </mi><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi><mi> </mi><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mi>s</mi><mo>,</mo></math> which of the following statements (s) is (are) true about the particle?

options.text: The velocity  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math>  is given by  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>v</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>10</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>10</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mi> </mi><mi>m</mi><msup><mrow><mi>s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>

The angular momentum  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>L</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math>  with respect to the origin is given by  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>L</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mi> </mi><mi>N</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>s</mi></math>

The force  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>F</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math>  is given by  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>F</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mi>N</mi></math>

The torque  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>τ</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math>  with respect to the origin is given by  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>τ</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mn>20</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mi> </mi><mi>N</mi><mi>m</mi><mi> </mi></math>
